# WellDesk

> WellDesk is practice management software for dietitians: client tracking, a diet plan builder with a built-in food database, payment tracking, appointment scheduling, in-app messaging, and a branded client portal — replacing the spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and notebooks most solo and small dietitian practices run on today.

WellDesk is free during early access. Each practice's client and health data is isolated at the database level and never visible to other practices on the platform.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.welldesk.app/): overview, features, and FAQ
- [About](https://www.welldesk.app/about): why WellDesk exists and how it handles practice data

- [Dietitian login](https://www.welldesk.app/login)
- [Client portal login](https://www.welldesk.app/portal/login)
